project.description: The {@link ReliabilityMl.Project} for which this spec must be instantiated.

models.description: A list of {@link ReliabilityMlModel}s that should be retrained as part of the automated retraining job.

title:
Defines the specification for executing an automated model retraining job within the {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator}.
This type configures which {@link ReliabilityMlModel}s should be retrained for a given {@link ReliabilityMl.Project},
enabling automated workflows for model selection and retraining.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.AutomatedRetrainingJobSpec
